messages:
Eli (Content): quick catch  need final microcopy for the tri-mode landing (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), 2 social captions, and the webinar CTA. also exact form routing for inbound flows. goal: tiny, testable variants for staging by 6pm PT.

Sam (Growth): Ill handle socials + timing. plan: announce -> reminder -> livestream. A/B on 'lower unit cost' vs 'predictable tails'. will include UTM templates.

Harper - PMM: Ill do subheads and tighten webinar bullets. focus on buyer outcomes: ship time, predictable billing, and compliance guardrails. no hard metrics.

Ravi (Ops): routing rules draft below. detect company domain + enterprise keywords. set priority if company_size>500 or compliance checked. include utm_campaign and event_id for all signups.

```
form_type -> destination_queue (conditions)
contact:demo -> sales-enterprise (company_email OR company_size>500)
signup:trial -> growth-trials (company_email)
signup:self-serve -> onboarding-freemium (personal_email)
question:compliance -> solutions-eng (compliance:true)
support:incident -> eng-oncall (severity:high)
```

Eli (Content): hero options (pick 1 per mode, keep <8 words):
- Hosted: "Fast API access for production LLMs."
- Hosted (alt): "Start shipping LLM features today."
- Dedicated: "Reserved GPUs for predictable throughput."
- Dedicated (alt): "Committed capacity with SLA-backed performance."
- Private: "Run inference inside your network."
- Private (alt): "On-prem & VPC for regulated workloads."

Harper - PMM: subheads (short):
- Hosted: "Prototype to product with predictable latency and pricing."
- Dedicated: "Steady throughput, predictable unit cost, SLA options."
- Private: "Full control over data residency and access policies."

Sam (Growth): social captions (drafts) + UTMs:
- Post A (cost angle): "Lower inference unit costs without sacrificing quality. See Hosted, Dedicated, and Private options + benchmarks. Webinar + demo -> [link]?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch&utm_medium=post"
- Post B (reliability angle): "Keep LLM features reliable in production: predictable latency, clear fallbacks, private deployment choices. RSVP -> [link]?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch&utm_medium=post"
- Reminder (24h): "Live demo tomorrow: choose the right mode for performance, cost, and compliance. Join for benchmarks + Q&A -> [link]?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch&utm_medium=reminder"

Harper - PMM: webinar headline + bullets:
Headline: "Practical Serving: Benchmarks and Decision Paths for Hosted, Dedicated, and Private"
Bullets:
- "What to measure: median latency, tail behavior, and cost/unit"
- "Decision rubric: pick the mode that fits throughput, risk, and compliance"
- "Operational playbook: rollouts, caching, and graceful fallbacks"

Ravi (Ops): ops notes: add form fields: company_email, company_size, compliance_checkbox, utm_campaign, event_id. if company_size>500 or compliance_checkbox=true then set priority=high and route to sales-enterprise. tag webinar signups with event_id and utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch.

StagingBot: reminder: deployment to /marketing/staging scheduled at 18:00 PT once all copy files are uploaded.

Eli (Content): assignments: Sam finalize social variants + UTMs; Harper finalize subheads + webinar copy; Ravi implement routing rules in CRM and confirm queue names; Ill compile landing microcopy and upload to staging for review. back here for quick signoff at 17:30 PT. :white_check_mark:
